result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but there are several visual defects: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant name is clipped mid-character where it collides with the rating, favorite-heart buttons are styled inconsistently between cards, and the second 'Popular right now' card is cut off/obscured by the bottom navigation bar without its name or details visible.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated mid-glyph (renders as 'Tokumaru Ramei') where it runs into the star rating on the same row. No ellipsis is shown, so the truncation looks like a rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with the rating pinned right, add a gap between them, and apply text-overflow: ellipsis with white-space: nowrap so long names truncate cleanly.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (the -20% pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and delivery info are not reachable, making the list feel broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll container equal to the height of the bottom tab bar so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the first card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the second card uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, size and icon color across all cards, or use a consistent scrim so it reads the same on any image.

issues.description: Horizontally scrolling rows (category chips and 'Fastest near you') clip their last items ('Healthy'/next chip, 'Trattoria Piccol…') right at the screen edge with no visual affordance, so it is unclear the rows scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add a peek/gutter on the right, an edge fade gradient, or a partial-card offset to signal horizontal scrolling, and let card captions ellipsize.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text label; if they also lack accessible names, screen-reader users get no context.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-labels / content descriptions such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen to favorites', and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44dp.
